Visit.title: Visit
Visit.description: Represents a single page visit for analytics.

path.description: The path of the page visited.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile in the Profolio application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

professionalTitle.description: The user's professional title, e.g., 'Senior Software Engineer'.

bio.description: A brief biography or personal statement of the user.

linkedinUrl.description: URL to the user's LinkedIn profile.

githubUrl.description: URL to the user's GitHub profile.

Experience.title: Experience
Experience.description: Represents a work experience entry in the user's CV.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Experience entity.

startDate.description: The start date of the employment.

endDate.description: The end date of the employment. Can be null if currently employed.

description.description: A description of the responsibilities and achievements.

Education.title: Education
Education.description: Represents an education entry in the user's CV.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Education entity.

institution.description: The name of the educational institution.

startDate.description: The start date of the education.

endDate.description: The end date of the education. Can be null if currently enrolled.

description.description: A description of the studies and achievements.

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: Represents a skill of the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Skill entity.

level.description: The proficiency level of the skill (e.g., 1-5).

description.description: A detailed description of the user's proficiency and experience with the skill.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: Represents a project showcased in the portfolio.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Project entity.

description.description: A detailed description of the project.

imageUrl.description: URL to the project's image or cover photo.

projectUrl.description: URL to the live project or its repository.

tagIds.description: References to Tags. (Relationship: Tag N:N Project)

views.description: The number of views the project has received.

gallery.description: A gallery of images or videos for the project.

Tag.title: Tag
Tag.description: Represents a tag or category for projects.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Tag entity.

ContactFormSubmission.title: ContactFormSubmission
ContactFormSubmission.description: Represents a submission from the contact form.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ContactFormSubmission entity.

email.description: The email address of the submitter.

submissionDate.description: The date and time of the submission.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to support the Profolio application, focusing on user profiles, experience, education, skills, projects, and tags. The primary principle is Authorization Independence, achieved by avoiding hierarchical authorization dependencies.  Each user's data is stored under their respective user ID, ensuring clear ownership. The structure supports QAPs by segregating data based on ownership, allowing secure list operations within a user's profile. Specifically, Experience, Education, Skill, Project, and Certificate collections are subcollections of `/users/{userId}`, so read operations on those collections are implicitly scoped to the user who owns the data. ContactFormSubmissions are stored in a separate collection, requiring specific security rules to control write access, and this keeps that separate from the data owned by users.
